snapshots.summary: India's documented ACC import dependence remained the last physical measurement, while the January 2022 PLI bid process represented a possible supply response rather than operating domestic supply.
snapshots.review_note: Do not refresh the import measurement with a policy/bid event. Obtain current cell imports, installed operating capacity, qualification and offtake before grading a later snapshot.

evidence.source_title: Cabinet approves PLI scheme for Advanced Chemistry Cell Battery Storage
evidence.claim: All ACC demand in India was then met through imports and domestic ACC manufacturing investment was negligible.

evidence.source_title: ACC PLI receives bids for about 130 GWh
evidence.source_publisher: Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Heavy Industries
evidence.claim: Ten applicants submitted bids totalling about 130 GWh; the programme required the manufacturing facility to be set up within two years.

snapshots.summary: Domestic module capacity was already material and a large PLI-linked pipeline was announced; this is a supply-response record, not proof that a module shortage remained investible.
snapshots.review_note: Verify commissioning, utilization, module imports and module pricing. Keep upstream cells and wafers separate from the resolved/overbuilt module layer.

evidence.source_title: Letters of Award issued for 48.3 GW of integrated solar PV manufacturing capacity
evidence.source_publisher: Press Information Bureau / Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
evidence.claim: ALMM-listed domestic solar PV module capacity was around 22 GW per annum, while letters of award covered around 48.3 GW of fully or partially integrated manufacturing capacity.
evidence.value_unit: GW per annum operating module capacity

evidence.source_title: Letters of Award issued for 48.3 GW of integrated solar PV manufacturing capacity
evidence.source_publisher: Press Information Bureau / Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
evidence.claim: The PLI letters of award covered around 48.3 GW of fully or partially integrated solar PV manufacturing capacity; an award is not commissioning proof.

snapshots.demand_unit: GW solar generation capacity added FY2022-23
snapshots.summary: The source separates the module and cell layers: India reported about 50 GW of module capacity but only about 6 GW of cell capacity, while imported solar cells totalled USD 1.31bn in FY2022-23.
snapshots.review_note: The data prove an exact-cell import/capacity problem but do not quantify imports as a share of cell demand. Capture cell production, consumption, utilization and current import share before upgrading to MEASURED.

evidence.source_title: India has achieved self-sufficiency in solar modules, but not substantial solar-cell capacity
evidence.source_publisher: Press Information Bureau / Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
evidence.claim: Installed solar-cell manufacturing capacity was around 6 GW, compared with around 50 GW of module capacity; the Ministry said substantial domestic cell capacity had not yet been achieved.

evidence.source_title: India has achieved self-sufficiency in solar modules, but not substantial solar-cell capacity
evidence.source_publisher: Press Information Bureau / Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
evidence.claim: FY2022-23 solar-cell imports were USD 1,310.30m; China supplied USD 581.45m of that recorded cell-import value.

evidence.source_title: India has achieved self-sufficiency in solar modules, but not substantial solar-cell capacity
evidence.source_publisher: Press Information Bureau / Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
evidence.claim: Solar generation capacity added in FY2022-23 was around 12.78 GW.
evidence.value_unit: GW solar generation capacity added FY2022-23

snapshots.demand_unit: MVA 765/400kV transformation capacity under implementation or bidding in TBCB pipeline
snapshots.summary: The transmission plan documents a large grid build-out pipeline. It is demand evidence for transformer and T&D research, not evidence that domestic transformer supply is physically short.
snapshots.review_note: Do not promote transformer makers on this row. Add exact transformer order-book, production capacity, lead-time, import and qualification data before creating a PHYSICAL_CONSTRAINT snapshot.

evidence.source_title: Draft National Electricity Plan, Volume II: Transmission
evidence.claim: The TBCB pipeline reported 52,500 MVA of 765/400kV transformation capacity under implementation and 97,500 MVA under bidding, excluding the commissioned cohort.

snapshots.summary: The 10 GWh ACC PLI re-bid award expands the announced supply response; it does not prove installed capacity or update the older import-dependence measurement.
snapshots.review_note: Confirm construction, pilot production, commercial commissioning, utilization and offtake. Do not infer operating domestic supply from a PLI award.

evidence.source_title: MHI awards 10 GWh capacity to one bidder under PLI ACC scheme
evidence.source_publisher: Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Heavy Industries
evidence.claim: Reliance Industries was awarded 10 GWh ACC capacity under the PLI scheme; this is an award and not operating-capacity evidence.

snapshots.summary: The Ministry of Steel still said CRGO technology was unavailable with Indian steelmakers, while lowering the PLI threshold to encourage domestic entry. This is current barrier evidence, not a quantified import or capacity gap.
snapshots.review_note: Capture annual CRGO imports, domestic qualified production, transformer demand and project commissioning before assigning a measured physical grade.

evidence.source_title: PLI Scheme 1.1 launched for specialty steel
evidence.source_publisher: Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Steel
evidence.claim: CRGO is used in HT power transformers and the Ministry stated that technology to make CRGO was unavailable with Indian steelmakers.

evidence.source_title: PLI Scheme 1.1 launched for specialty steel
evidence.source_publisher: Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Steel
evidence.claim: The CRGO PLI entry thresholds were reduced to INR 3,000 crore investment and 50,000 tonnes capacity, indicating a proposed supply response rather than operating supply.

snapshots.demand_unit: GW solar generation capacity added FY2022-23
snapshots.summary: The reported domestic module layer had reached self-sufficiency; imported modules remained visible in trade data, but this record removes a generic module-shortage thesis rather than excluding company-specific capacity ramp research.
snapshots.review_note: Do not use a resolved module shortage for a Buy. Module makers may remain research leads only where a separate company capacity/ramp/earnings thesis is evidenced; evaluate cells and wafers independently.

evidence.source_title: India has achieved self-sufficiency in solar modules, but not substantial solar-cell capacity
evidence.source_publisher: Press Information Bureau / Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
evidence.claim: Installed solar PV module manufacturing capacity was around 50 GW, and the Ministry said the country had achieved self-sufficiency in solar modules/panels.

evidence.source_title: India has achieved self-sufficiency in solar modules, but not substantial solar-cell capacity
evidence.source_publisher: Press Information Bureau / Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
evidence.claim: FY2022-23 solar-module imports were USD 943.53m; China supplied USD 874.89m of that recorded module-import value.

snapshots.summary: By February 2026, 40 GWh had been awarded under ACC PLI but only 1 GWh was installed, so announced capacity could not be treated as operating domestic supply.
snapshots.review_note: The source does not quantify current import share or total ACC demand. Refresh trade data and utilization before treating the 1 GWh observation as a measurable domestic supply/demand gap.

evidence.source_title: PLI scheme for Advanced Chemistry Cells
evidence.source_publisher: Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Heavy Industries
evidence.claim: The four PLI beneficiaries had 40 GWh awarded capacity in aggregate, but only 1 GWh installed; no beneficiary had claimed an incentive.

evidence.source_title: PLI scheme for Advanced Chemistry Cells
evidence.source_publisher: Press Information Bureau / Ministry of Heavy Industries
evidence.claim: The same source recorded 40 GWh awarded capacity against a 50 GWh programme target, while making clear that awards were not operating capacity.
